programme.desc: Morskaben begynder i Miami, da politiaspiranten Dave Speed spillet af den hysterisk morsomme Terence Hill, sendes ud til et øde sumpområde for at aflevere en bøde. Da han kommer derud, udsættes han ved et uheld for et radioaktivt stof...

programme.title: Cement i armen
programme.desc: Rulleskøjteløberen Rosco får et lift med lastbilchaufføren Mason, men de bliver stoppet af færdselspolitiet, som tror at de er to bankrøvere.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Lucky Stars DA
programme.desc: En meddeler på ferie i Thailand bliver opsøgt og myrdet af mafiaens lakejer, men lige får sin død fortæller han kommissær Woo, at han har sendt et brev med informationen til en ven hjemme i Hongkong.

programme.title: Game of Death DA
programme.desc: Filmstjernen Billy må gang på gang tage sig af en kriminel bande, der presser penge af ham, og bandens leder er utilfreds, at Billy nægter at lade sig skræmme. Vil en hyret lejemordet blive Billys endegyldige overmand?

programme.title: Winners and Sinners
programme.desc: Fem venner bliver løsladt fra fængslet. De har bestemt sig for at leve hæderlige liv fremover, og sammen starter de et rengøringsfirma. Men samme dag løslades også en sjette fange og hans planer er at tjene penge på falskmøntneri.

programme.title: The Young Master
programme.desc: Efter at Dragon er blevet bedraget af sin egen bror, Tiger, står de to som repræsentanter for rivaliserende skoler i den årlige løvedansekonkurrence. Selv om Tiger vinder, tvinges han i eksil af vanæren ved at have forrådt sine egne.

programme.title: FGIRL Island: Jeg besværger dig
programme.desc: CJ tror, han kan stole på sine tre kvinder, men en af dem chokerer Nikki under til en terapitime. Casey kan lide Hannah, så Camille og Michi kaster en besværgelse for at standse kærligheden. Elimineringerne vender op og ned på alt.

programme.title: FGIRL Island: Fejl Swift
programme.desc: Svære valg træffes, og mændene chokerer alle med deres sidste elimineringer.

programme.title: FGIRL Island: Kløerne er ude
programme.desc: Tingene bliver sexede og farlige mellem kvinderne og mændene. Nikki Glaser dukker op og en kvinde bliver forsmået.

programme.title: FGIRL Island: Elskere eller løgnere
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen afsløres elskernes og løgnernes identiteter. Drengene fortryder deres uheldige beslutninger, og en kvinde træffer det mest dramatiske valg i Lovers and Liars' historie.

programme.title: FBoy Island: This Is Gonna Be A Good Season
programme.desc: Hali, Daniella og den tidligere Bachelorette Katie møder F-boys og Nice Guys, som kæmper for at gøre et godt første indtryk. En uventet besked ryster fyrene.

programme.title: FBoy Island: I Care, Bro
programme.desc: Fra akavede kys til en sexet striptease - deltagerne giver den gas på deres dates. Men hvor der er kærlighed, er der jalousi. Marco taler over sig, og spillet viser sig hårdere end forventet, hvilket fører til tårevædede afskeder.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at the English National Ballet School, where Lisa introduces them to ballet teacher Louise Halliday. They learn about the art of ballet to help with their movement.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls order a pizza and find Lisa Mail for the challenge the following morning. A huge fight breaks out between Stefanie and Louise.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls are taken to Debenhams, where they get the chance to meet Caprice. They are given fifteen minutes to find an outfit for different occasions.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at a bar where they meet music video director Paul Hills. Their challenge is to star in a music video along with The Wolfmen.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls are woken up by a grueling morning workout from Celebrity Personal Trainer Nicki Waterman. Some struggle with the workout, especially Sherece.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at Models 1, where they meet Mark Evans along with casting agents. They take a Polaroid shot for a casting. Mark announces that they will be going to Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, but there are only four places on the plane.

programme.title: Bejleren - en jydsk røverhistorie
programme.desc: Sejr og Maren elsker hinanden men kan ikke blive gift så længe herremanden nægter Sejr en fæstegård. Røvere hærger imidlertid egnen, og herremanden lover Sejr en gård, hvis han kan fange dem. Samtidig kommer en mystisk fremmed og anholder om Marens hånd.

programme.title: Vores lille by

programme.title: Da Svante Forsvandt
programme.desc: Om lidt er kaffen klar. Svantes viser i en munter spillefilm om lyrikeren Svante Svendsen, der sidst blev set i 1971. Han eftersøges af skolekammeraten og vennen Benny Andersen, der har sat musik til hans tekster.

programme.title: Man sku' være noget ved musikken
programme.desc: Handlingen i denne komedie udspiller sig i og omkring værtshuset Café Strudsen i København. Almindelige mennesker, der har hver sit at slås med.

programme.title: Love Island All Stars - Sæson 1
programme.desc: Spændingerne hænger i luften efter Heart Rate-udfordringen, mens sladder og usikkerheder breder sig i villaen. Et afslørende spil viser offentlighedens meninger — og ikke alle tager resultaterne pænt.

programme.title: Love Island All Stars - Sæson 1
programme.desc: Spændingerne koger efter et hedt opgør, men kærligheden kommer hurtigt i fokus, når drengene planlægger romantiske Valentinsdag-dates. Søde øjeblikke og store gestusser smelter hjerter i hele villaen.

programme.title: Love Island All Stars - Sæson 1
programme.desc: Følelserne sidder uden på tøjet, da venskaber brister, og pigerne modtager overraskende videoopkald fra deres kære. Tårer, grin og hjertelige råd fylder villaen med ny energi og refleksion.

programme.title: Love Island All Stars - Sæson 1
programme.desc: Rygter, spændinger og romantik fylder villaen, mens følelserne koger. Nogle par kommer tættere på hinanden, mens andre støder sammen — og en nat i Hideaway byder på både hede, grin og drama.

programme.title: Love Island All Stars - Sæson 1
programme.desc: En uge med hidtil uset kaos, flirtende sjov og sjove øjeblikke – fra villa-spil og søde overraskelser til uventede grin og frække indrømmelser. Islanderne afslutter ugen i ægte villa-stil.

programme.title: Harlequin: Diamond Girl
programme.desc: Playboy-advokaten Denny kaster aldrig et blik på sin kedelige, men loyale assistent Claire . Men da han opdager, at hun er en usleben diamant, beslutter han sig for at forvandle hende til en skønhed. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game
programme.desc: Sarah og Amy, der har været bedste venner siden college, arrangerer deres første kunstudstilling i en lille by i New England. Da mystiske fremmede træder ind i deres forsigtige liv og udfolder sig et mysterium.Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: Da Robert får at vide, at hans bror er omkommet i en bådulykke, tager han af sted for at hente liget og møder Evie Shaw. Han bliver besat af sin brors mistænkelige død... og af Evie. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 705
programme.desc: En mand prøver at sælge sin kærestes ring i al hemmelighed, og butikken har aldrig set mage til den straf, hun giver ham. Les kævles med en potentiel køber, men vil hans grådighed overmande ham?

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 706
programme.desc: Les bliver fristet til at gå imod butiksreglementet med en kunde. Men går hele planen i vasken, da Seth kommer tilbage?

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 707
programme.desc: En kunde har gemt sig i et køleskab, og Ashley er sikker på, at han ville vente til lukketid og så berøve dem. Hun kræver, at de ansætter sikkerhedsfolk til om natten, men Les er ikke enig.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 708
programme.desc: Les køber en masse ting, som Seth og Ashley hævder er værdiløse. Da hans børn afslører baglokalet som er fyldt med alt fra Pontiacs til proteser, er Les afsløret. Er han hoarder eller sælger?

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 709
programme.desc: En kunde vil sælge en krukke guldpulver, der kan være flere tusinde dollars værd, men Ashley er overbevist om, at det bare er øjenskygge. En eksplosiv syretest afslører, om det er guld eller fup.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 710
programme.desc: En konflikt over en falsk kvittering eskalerer. Men da Les forsøger at tage kunden på fersk gerning, kommer hun tilbage med en advokat, der kan få Les i problemer.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 711
programme.desc: Ashley udfordrer Seth til en konkurrence, der kan få favoritdrengen på dybt vand. Hvis han ikke kan levere varen, vil verden høre den hemmelighed, han så inderligt har kæmpet for at holde skjult.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 712
programme.desc: Les' børn opdager, at deres anden butik stille og roligt er ved at gå konkurs. Da de konfronterer Les med at sælge stedet, flipper han ud og gør det meget tydeligt, at butikken ikke er til salg.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 713
programme.desc: Seths hemmelige plan om at sælge Pontiac er i fuld gang, men da der går noget galt, trækkes Ashley ind i balladen. De arbejder på at mødes med en sælger og ender i et livsændrende scenarium.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 801
programme.desc: Les ikke tilgive eller glemme Seths forræderi. Butikken fungerer ikke uden Les, men han sidder inde på sit kontor og nægter at tale med nogen. Imidlertid går der en slåskamp i gang i butikken.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: This Hangover Better Be Expensive

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Brody Gets Away with So Much

programme.desc: En chokerende Hemmelighedssauna betyder, at singlerne må være på vagt ved isceremonien. Allie og Nialls ustabile forhold gør Allie usikker.

programme.desc: Gamle konflikter kommer op til overfladen og et stort skænderi fører til chok og tårer. Med kun to parceremonier tilbage prøver deltagerne desperat at lave en strategi for at vinde.

programme.desc: Malcoms opfører sig som en rigtig player og kommer i klemme mellem Diandra og Nurys. Keith og Alexis prøver at knuse hinandens hjerter ved at date andre.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Carrie Fisher, Rue McClanahan, John Waters, Federico Castelluccio

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Choice

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Worst Fear
programme.desc: Police are shocked to find a 13-year-old boy killed in an explosion, but their grief turns to alarm when they discover a second, unexploded bomb.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Outlaw
programme.desc: When a gunfight erupts at a local biker bar and claims the lives of two men, Lt. Joe Kenda must delve deep into the world of an infamous biker gang.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Time Bomb
programme.desc: In 1978, Lt. Joe Kenda is new to the CSPD, and gets more than he bargains for when a local bank is the target of a massive explosion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Timothy Peart’s Last Dance
programme.desc: When a teen is killed at a party, police question the guests and wonder if they’re all part of a cover-up.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Knock Knock
programme.desc: A gathering of friends turns deadly when two gunmen shoot William Davis in the head. Kenda and his team dig into his past and start to suspect someone in William’s circle is lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: New Year's Evil
programme.desc: It’s New Year’s Eve weekend, and in the midst of the revelry Miguel Mendez is beaten to death outside a convenience store. Lt. Joe Kenda faces a challenging investigation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Windows to Other Worlds / Fountain of Creation
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Advances, Cassini at Saturn & More About Mars
programme.desc: Project Gemini Advances - NASA refines the techniques needed for rendezvous. Cassini at Saturn - In the Cassini probe's final years of activity, its handlers are asking it to do more complex and risky assignments.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 4: Black Holes
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 8: Extravehicular Activity
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication
programme.desc: Project Gemini Commences - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? Venus Express - The last days of ESA's Venus probe. EMU - NASA's Extravehicular Mobility Unit. Deep Space Communications - ESA's worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: An eccentric city commissioner, famed for his wild outbursts at commission meetings, is suspected of brutally beating an immunology professor and his wife.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A Kentucky river town is shocked when the owner of a popular restaurant is bludgeoned to death with an antique pancake syrup bottle and her husband is charged.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Efren Saldivar
programme.desc: Efren Saldivar confessed to killing 40 to 50 patients over an eight-year period. Quickly christened an "Angel of Death," he targeted patients who were already near death.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Karen Pedley
programme.desc: The case of care home worker Karen Pedley who was given 14 life sentences in 2016. Deeply affected by a fire at her home when she was a child, Pedley developed into a pyromaniac.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Sandra Weir
programme.desc: The story of Sandra Weir, who acted as a carer for her elderly neighbor. But she was stealing from the pensioner to fund her drug addiction, leading to a tragic confrontation.

programme.title: Myth Hunters

programme.desc: From Darwin’s original specimens to a lost workshop that inspired James Bond, discover the secrets of Britain’s Natural History Museum.

programme.desc: Som tidligere krigsfotograf har Nanna Kreutzmann dokumenteret katastrofer og konflikter, men som fridykker og undervandsfotograf, fandt hun en verden, der kunne give hende ro, langt fra den upålidelige verden på landjorden.

programme.desc: Lorena Bobbitt stops by to chat about her work supporting domestic violence survivors, her resiliency and where things stand with John Wayne Bobbitt now. Plus, "Sonic the Hedgehog 2" star Ben Schwartz joins Drew and Ross Mathews at the Drew's News desk.

programme.desc: A sexual predator viciously murders a 16 year old girl. Can investigators catch him before he kills again?

programme.title: On the Case: The Day After Christmas
programme.desc: A man and his girlfriend are attacked by a mysterious intruder in their home. Despite near fatal wounds, she survives and helps investigators solve the crime.

programme.title: On the Case: Same Crime Next Year
programme.desc: A teenager is found murdered on the weekend of the Daytona 500 motor race in Daytona Beach, Florida. Then, one year later, police are called to the scene of a nearly identical crime.

programme.title: On the Case: Nine Days of Terror
programme.desc: When a young college student disappears out of a mall parking lot, police find themselves in a race against time to find her before it is too late.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Second Chances

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Snowplane

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dogfight
programme.desc: Buffalo's top guns, rookies and vets, go to California for aerial dogfights in real fighter planes. Cory and Mikey race to get ready for the D-Day jump.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Coming Home
programme.desc: Rookie waterbomber pilot Scott gets his first taste of action when Buffalo responds to an emergency callout to fight fires in Alberta. Mikey and Rod think they hit the jackpot when they buy a million dollar firefighting plane on eBay at a bargain price.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Thin Ice
programme.desc: C-46 and DC-4 crews race against the spring melt to fly mining equipment to an airstrip on a frozen lake. Jeremy tries to catch up to fellow rampies Audrey and Wilf.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Camp
programme.desc: Mikey trains for High Arctic survival with the Canadian Rangers. The Air Force invades Chuck's hangar. Joe faces tough competition at a California plane auction.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Clown Did It
programme.desc: A report on the 1990 murder of Marlene Warren, and the decades long hunt for her killer: a clown bearing balloons, flowers and a gun.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Live to Tell: Trafficked
programme.desc: An examination of sex trafficking through the eyes of survivor Alyssa Beck and the vast array of people who tried to help her – from law enforcement and her family, to the legal system and child advocates.

programme.title: 48 Hours: What Happened in Apartment 4C?
programme.desc: A report on the 2016 disappearance and murder of Joey Comunale after a night of partying in New York City. While out clubbing, Comunale accepted an invitation to a party at a Sutton Place apartment with people he had just met.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Private Needham's War
programme.desc: A report on the case of Pvt. John Needham, a decorated soldier diagnosed with traumatic brain injury and PTSD, and investigators say beat his 19-year-old girlfriend Jacque Villagomez to death with his bare hands in September 2008.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Don't Scream
programme.desc: An investigation on Tiffany Mead of Davis County, Utah, a young mother who called 911 claiming she had sliced her own throat while her ex-husband and child watched.

programme.title: 48 Hours: FindJodi!
programme.desc: A report on new information in the search for Iowa television anchor Jodi Huisentruit, who disappeared on her way to work on June 27, 1995.

programme.desc: An officer finds a woman asleep at the wheel in the middle of a highway, deputies investigate a possible kidnapping, and a nervous driver just wants to be honest with police.

programme.title: COPS: Dead End Dash

programme.title: COPS: Four Felonies and a Flat Tire
programme.desc: A suspected car thief's claims of innocence are undermined by a video he shot of himself earlier that day, and the pursuit of a suspected drunk driver has a surprising end.

programme.title: COPS: Pants Party
